hypotheses.reasoning: template-svc reloaded MAILER_API_KEY from the secrets store at 12:03:10 (version 17, with version 16 revoked, #114). From 12:04:07 onward every call to the email provider fails with 401 Unauthorized (invalid API key) (#117, #122, #128). This is the earliest anomaly that is not a benign GC or rate-limit line. The rotation left template-svc on a credential the provider rejects, so /render fails, notification-svc gets 502 from template-svc (#130, #146), and api-gateway returns 502 on POST /v1/notify (#121, #139, #144, #157). The 502s at the gateway and notification-svc are downstream symptoms and are not cited as root cause. notif-db, redis and notif-worker show no errors, which rules out data-layer and queue causes. The 429 throttle on k-2741 at #19 is unrelated and predates the onset by about an hour. Alternative: external_outage, but a 401 means the credential is rejected, not that the provider is down, so this is less likely.
The provider is rejecting requests, which could be read as a provider-side problem. However, the 401 is an auth rejection tied to the key rotation at #114, so this is a weak alternative.

verdict.recommendedAction: Fix the credential in template-svc. Confirm that the version 17 MAILER_API_KEY is valid with the mailer provider and that template-svc is actually using it. If the reload did not take effect, force a re-read or restart template-svc so it stops sending the revoked version 16 key. Verify that POST /render and POST /v1/notify return to 200 and that the 401 count drops to zero. Then review the key rotation runbook so an old key is not revoked until every consumer has picked up the new version.
